storageUri.description: The creating instruction's URI, recorded on the event. Append-only, so this value never changes — the LOCATION the projection serves is maintained across moves and lives on the resource's primary Representation, relocated by yield:moved. Optional: a resource may have no bytes. Working-tree URI, only file:// is supported (e.g. file://docs/overview.md).

jobId.description: The job this resource was made in fulfilment of, when its create cited one. A write that cites the same job on this resource, by the one who made it, is attributed to that job's requester: the `creator` here.

generatedFrom.description: What this resource was generated from: the resource, and the annotation on it when the generation was for one. The resource's descriptor names the resource as `wasDerivedFrom`.

creator.description: Who requested this resource — derived by the knowledge base at write time, never sent by the emitter. For a resource created in fulfilment of a job, the requester recorded on that job's job:assigned; otherwise the emitter itself. Absent on events written before derivation existed, whose emitter was their only party.

wasAttributedTo.description: PROV-O wasAttributedTo, derived at write time from `creator` and the executor: both parties when they differ, one when they are the same. The value the resource view carries; readers do not re-derive it.
